'''Voyla''' was a male [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Voyla was spying with [[Cham Syndulla/Legends|Cham Syndulla]] on the docking bay in the city of [[Lessu City/Legends|Lessu]] when the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]] [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]], [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]] arrived to meet with a corpulent Twi'lek broker named [[Artruk]].
